policies.name: Users mark own daily matches seen
Users freeze own daily top set
Users read own daily top sets
Users read jobs they have a relationship with
policies.qual:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM applications a
  WHERE ((a.job_id = jobs.id) AND (a.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM saved_jobs s
  WHERE ((s.job_id = jobs.id) AND (s.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM dismissed_jobs d
  WHERE ((d.job_id = jobs.id) AND (d.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: Referral parties read own rows
policies.qual: ((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = referrer_id) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = referee_id))

views.def:
SELECT id,
    username,
    display_name,
    avatar_url
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM audits a
          WHERE ((a.user_id = p.id) AND (a.is_published = true))));
views.name: public_profiles
